title: City Gas Station Simulator
description: Ever dreamed of running a bustling gas station? City Gas Station Simulator lets you experience the thrill of managing every detail of your very own station in a fun 3D casual simulator! From fueling cars to running a mini shop, every choice is yours to make. Fun and addictive casual management gameplay. Mix shopping and service for maximum efficiency.

title: Build a Go-Kart
description:
Build your karting empire from scratch — from simple straights to complex tracks with boosts and risky turns.

Design unique tracks using modular blocks: combine elements, optimize your route, and find the perfect balance between speed and profit. Every ride earns money — and your track design determines how much you make.

title: Lemonade Tycoon Idle
description: Tap your way from a humble lemonade stand to a global empire! Serve customers, unlock upgrades, hire staff, and expand across the world. With a dynamic day/night cycle and relaxing lo-fi music, this is the ultimate idle lemonade experience.

title: Stickman Adventure
description: This is an adventure that will take you through time and space! Along the way, you'll encounter various traps and monsters; you'll need to defeat them and rescue your friends. Come on, Hero, a whole new world awaits!

title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
description:
Ready to experience a summer full of Solitaire?
Finally, it's summer! Time to relax! What's better than to lay back, listen to the smooth tunes, enjoy the warm breeze coming from the sea and play some Klondike Solitaire.
Your goal in Solitaire Summer is simple, yet so addictive: Arrange all cards sorted by color in 4 stacks, from lowest to highest value. Can you remove all cards in the correct order and solve the Solitaire Summer puzzle?

title: Mojicon Garden JigSolitaire
description: Piece together a paradise in Mojicon Garden Jigsaw Solitaire! Solve beautiful puzzles to restore a dry meadow back to a lush, blooming garden. Enjoy a meditative experience with smooth controls and the iconic Mojicon art style. Can you bring the garden back to life?

title: Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d
description: Roll your block across challenging 3D platforms and drop it into the goal hole to solve each puzzle. Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d is an addictive block puzzle game that tests your logic, spatial thinking, and problem-solving skills across dozens of mind-bending levels.

title: Pato Vs Cops
description: lay Pato Vs Cops — the ultimate free browser police chase game! No download needed — jump into nonstop car chases, dodge roadblocks, and outdrive relentless cops in fast-paced arcade action. Perfect for fans of unblocked racing games, endless car chase games, and online driving challenges. Show off your reflexes, collect power-ups, and see how long you can survive the heat in this thrilling high-speed pursuit!

title: Power Puzzle
description:
In Power Puzzle, you take control of a growing electrical network. Connect generators, route power through the grid, and bring every building to life — but every move matters.

? Gameplay
Connect power lines from generators to buildings
Manage limited connections and avoid inefficient routes
Every level is a handcrafted puzzle with increasing complexity
Multiple solutions are possible — can you find the most optimal one?

title: Live 100 Days
description: Survive 100 days in a chaotic life simulation where every choice matters. Manage danger, resources, and unexpected events as you try to stay alive for as long as possible.

title: Match Dream Garden
description: What a beautiful garden! Match leaves, flowers, apples and other items to progress. Use power-ups like the Hammer to remove any piece, the Rake to clear an entire row or column, or the Gardening Gloves to swap two pieces.

title: Belote 3in1
description:
Play 3 of the most popular card games with smart & powerful AI co-players, who won’t forget the game’s rules:
- French Belote – the original: a trick-taking game played by four players in two teams, using a 32-card deck, and featuring Ace-Ten cards. 
- Contrée – a variant of Belote with advanced bidding options.
- Coinche – a variant of Belote with even further advanced bidding options, declarations, and No Trumps & All Trump modes.

title: Stacking Match
description: Jenga match is a very fun puzzle game. Players need to pull out blocks of a certain color from a multi-layered tower of blocks. The pulled block will fly into the corresponding colored square. When there are three blocks of the same color in a square, it will eliminated, and a new square will appear. How many levels you can play?

title: Pogo Masters
description: Bounce into action in Pogo Masters! Race against rivals in chaotic, physics-based platform battles where balance is everything. Compete online against players worldwide or challenge a friend locally on the same PC. Unlock dozens of unique characters, stylish pogo sticks, and eye-catching trail effects as you climb the global leaderboard. Fast-paced, competitive, and endlessly fun — become the ultimate pogo champion!

title: Float for Brainrots
description: Float for Brainrots is a chaotic water adventure game where you collect rare Brainrots across dangerous seas. Start with a simple raft, unlock powerful boats, upgrade speed and capacity, and explore deeper waters for better rewards. Manage your timer, avoid sharks, and use islands to survive. Play solo or with a friend in 2 player mode and build your ultimate Brainrot collection.

title: Arrow Sorting
description: Arrow! Sorting Food is a satisfying puzzle adventure where every move changes the board. Tap the arrows to unravel colorful fruit chains, clear paths, and untangle tricky patterns across countless levels. Unlock new visual themes, collect fun skins, and enjoy relaxing yet brain-teasing gameplay that grows more challenging with every stage. Simple to learn, surprisingly addictive to master!

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Your favorite pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to save them and punish the alien bullies. Evolve to defeat stronger enemies, free new dogs, get unique resources so that your dogs can evolve! Collect all the dog breeds and see how cool they will be! Discover new territories, visit the beach, park, city square and forest!

title: Bears vs. Art
description:
Bears vs. Art is the premium version of the slash em’ up puzzle game you love! Exclusive to this version of Bears vs. Art - enjoy uninterrupted, thought-provoking puzzles.
Each painting is protected by sneaky security measures including lasers, spikes and mind-bending portals. Not to mention snooty guests, nosy security guards and art-snatching thieves!

title: TRIVIA NATION
description:
Test your knowledge with quick and fun trivia questions!

Play through multiple categories including sports, movies, history, science, and more.
Challenge yourself in fast-paced quiz rounds and improve your brain skills.

Perfect for all ages — play solo or compete with friends and family!

• 400+ questions
• Multiple categories
• Fast and addictive gameplay
• Multilingual support

title: Emoji Frenzy
description:
Test your reflexes and knowledge in this fast-paced emoji matching game! 
Tap the correct emoji before time runs out, build streaks, and unlock new themes. Simple to play, hard to master!

title: Oreplication
description: Sandbox strategy tycoon where you design factories for infinite wealth. Start with basic droppers & conveyors, upgrade to advanced machines. Deep progression, mystery boxes, endless optimization—build, outsmart, ascend in the ultimate factory challenge!

title: Word Game 2026
description: Immerse yourself in "Word Puzzle," a premium brain-teasing game featuring a stunning 3D animated background! Test your vocabulary and fast-thinking skills by guessing the missing letters before the thrilling 30-second timer runs out. With 100 exciting levels, neon-glassmorphism graphics, and highly addictive gameplay, this game will keep you hooked for hours. Can you become the ultimate Word Master?

title: Match Ten Number Puzzle
description: Ready to put your brain to the test in a fun and relaxing way? Match Ten - Number Puzzle is a clever puzzle game that combines simple rules with surprisingly deep strategy. Once you start, you won’t want to stop! As levels progress, the board becomes more complex, and every number choice matters. Plan carefully, think ahead, and keep the board under control! If you enjoy number-based puzzle games, this one is a must-play!

title: Stick: Tactics & Destruction
description: Stick: Tactics & Destruction! For fans of Stick War, Teardown, and Playground. Limited ammo, grenades, monsters, explosions. Destroy everything and win!

title: Bubble Pop Legend
description:
Bubble Pop Legend is the best way to kill time.
Aim & shoot to pop all colorful bubbles to clear the board and win coins.
You'll spend hours with fun & addictive Bubble Pop Legend to keep your mind active.

▶ How to Play

• Aim carefully and tap where you want to shoot
• Match 3 or more bubbles of same color to pop them
• Pop all colorful bubbles to win levels
• Use less shots to get higher score and earn 3 stars
• Plan and use epic boosters at the right time to BLAST ALL LEVELS

title: Zombie Rush
description:
Zombies Rush is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter that pits a lone survivor against an endless, evolving horde. Built for fluid action, this 2D arcade shooter, turns every escape into a high-stakes dance with death.
Tilt and weave through trees to outmaneuver the rush.
Each wave brings faster, smarter, and deadlier undead threats.
Experience a modern take on the classic zombie survival genre with clean, stylized graphics and kinetic combat.

title: Coin Blitz
description: Fast-paced coin shooting action! Destroy waves of enemies, collect tons of coins, and grow stronger as you play. Drag and position your shooter strategically while watching satisfying coin explosions and smooth gameplay. Simple to start, hard to master — how long can you survive?

title: Apocalypse Shelter
description: The world has fallen — but survival is still possible. Build and expand your shelter, manage resources, and create a safe haven in a hostile environment. Assemble a squad of unique heroes, each with their own abilities and combat style. Engage in tactical turn-based battles, plan your moves, and use your team’s skills to overcome dangerous enemies. Unlock new characters from chests, upgrade their cards, and build the ultimate squad to survive the apocalypse.

title: Snake Puzzle Escape
description: Get ready for a fast-paced puzzle experience where your goal is to wiggle the snake through each grid while avoiding obstacles and other snakes. With simple controls and a variety of challenging levels, this is the perfect game for quick play during your free time.

title: Car Parking Simulator
description: Car Parking Simulator is a driving challenge game you won't be able to put down! Whether you want to tackle challenging levels or practice precision parking, you can choose from different modes to start your adventure. From compact car models to heavy-duty truck options, every level offers a fresh driving challenge. As you progress, the levels become more demanding, turning every success into a rewarding challenge.

title: Office Pyramid Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Pyramid Solitaire is to clear the card pyramid. On hard difficulty you must also clear the draw deck.

title: Ship & Fish
description: Ship & Fish is an exciting survival game where the player controls a ship and tries to stay alive by avoiding dangerous fish. The game requires fast reflexes and smart movement, as fish attack from all directions. The longer you survive, the higher your score grows and the more challenging the game becomes.

title: Caterfall 2048
description: Caterfall 2048 is a vibrant reimagining of the classic 2048 puzzle set in a cozy feline atmosphere. It combines familiar merging mechanics with a hexagonal grid and fun "jelly" physics. This game is perfect for all puzzle lovers — whether you want to relax or you're a competitive player striving for a new high score.

title: Obby Champions
description: A journey awaits you where every wall is a challenge, every obstacle is an ancient seal, and every punch is a step towards legend. Explore unique zones, fight titans, and find rare pets with unique abilities. Enter hidden codes, collect fragments of history, and leave your mark in the Hall of Echoes - only the strongest will be able to break all the seals and become the Fist of Legends!

title: Wool Sorting
description:
Wool Sorting is a super relaxing and addictive yarn-connecting puzzle game!
In LEVEL 2, slide and merge colorful wool segments to create perfect complete threads. Match colors and sequences with precision — simple to play, yet deeply satisfying!
Challenge yourself across LV.10, 15 & 20. Soothing, brain-teasing fun for any moment!

title: Tap Bead
description: Tap Bead is a relaxing puzzle game. Arrange beads by color to match patterns and clear levels. Simple controls, soft visuals, and many levels make it a soothing, satisfying experience.

title: Hidden Paint 3D
description: Coloring 3D is a relaxing and creative game where you bring the world to life with color. Tap objects to instantly paint them in bright, beautiful shades and watch scenes transform. Simple controls and calm gameplay make it perfect for all ages and stress-free fun.

title: Ninja Survivor
description: Become a nimble ninja and embark on a dangerous adventure through many levels filled with traps, enemies, and puzzles. Explore colorful 3D locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight zombies and powerful bosses using speed, reflexes, and strategy. Each level requires focus and skill. Upgrade your character, unlock new weapons, and collect stylish skins to grow stronger and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Fruit Match
description:
A fresh twist on fruit puzzles!
Tap two identical fruits to detach them and send them falling into the basket.

But it’s not that simple — fruits follow real physics. They can get stuck, stack, and only fall further when you clear what’s below.
Use gravity to your advantage, trigger chain reactions, and watch satisfying cascades unfold.

Clear the board and keep the flow going as new fruits drop in!

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online game takes the familiar lucky box idea and turns it into a more active risk-and-return loop. You move through 14 areas, open boxes, collect brainrots, and decide whether to head back safely or keep pushing for rarer finds. Online play is available through 1 Player mode, while local 2-player adds a same-screen option for faster, more chaotic sessions. Rebirth, speed upgrades, better boxes, base expansion, and roaming bosses keep every run moving forward.

title: Kitty Match 3 puzzle game
description:
Kitty Match is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game with adorable cats. Match tiles, create combos, and clear levels in a relaxing and colorful world.

Easy to play and perfect for all ages. Enjoy smooth gameplay and endless puzzle fun.

Start your cute cat adventure now!

title: Hopnova
description: Hopnova is a fastpaced vertical adventure where every jump takes you closer to the stars. Guide your little explorer across floating platforms, avoid dangers, and discover powerups that boost you higher and higher. Chase new heights, beat your best scores, and enjoy quick, addictive gameplay perfect for short, exciting sessions.

title: Arrow Count Master
description: Arrow Count Master is a fast and satisfying runner where every choice changes your firepower. Swipe to move and choose between gates that add, subtract, multiply, or boost your arrows. Build the biggest arrow count possible while avoiding penalties and obstacles along the way.

title: Dusty Cat
description: Help the little speck of dust to grow into a real cat! Eat other dust, avoid larger enemies and grow to see all the phases of your Dusty Cat! Collect points and compete with other players to get your scores on the leaderboard!

title: Snake Go - Escape Puzzle
description: Your goal is simple: guide the snake through tangled grids and help it escape without getting stuck. Each level challenges you to think ahead, choose the right order, and find safe paths through tight spaces. Blending classic snake mechanics with modern puzzle escape logic, every maze feels handcrafted — clean, clever, and satisfying to solve.

title: Space Cleaner
description:
Space Cleaner is a casual space arcade game where you clear dangerous asteroid fields around your spacecraft. Use your mouse to destroy nearby asteroids, earn money, and survive as long as your fuel lasts.

When your fuel runs out, upgrade your ship’s abilities and return to space to continue cleaning the asteroid field. Destroy every asteroid to complete the stage and unlock the next challenge.

title: ChickZ Stack
description:
ChickZ Stack is a fun and addictive arcade game where flying chickens take to the sky! stack your chickens to overcome obstacles and glide through colorful, challenging levels.

The taller your chicken stack, the easier it is to pass walls, traps, and enemies.

Unlock adorable flying chickens, explore new worlds, and compete for high scores.

With simple one-tap controls and fast-paced gameplay, ChickZ Stack is easy to play but hard to master.

Stack, fly, and flap your way to victory!

title: Bubble Shooter Vintage
description:
Play the vintage classic - Bubble Shooter!

One of the most compelling bubble shooter games is available for FREE!
Aim your cannon, SHOOT and match three same color bubbles to pop your way to the highest score.

title: GenFire
description:
GenFire is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where players fight endless waves of enemies in intense 360° combat.

Survive increasingly difficult levels, defeat elemental creatures, and collect coins while mastering your strategy.

Features:
- 20 handcrafted levels across multiple chapters
- Unique enemy mechanics including splitting fire slimes and bosses
- Skill-based gameplay with increasing difficulty

title: Blue VS Red
description: Sort blue and red items as fast as you can! Drag or use arrow keys to send each item to the correct zone. Build combos, beat the timer, and earn coins to buy power-ups. Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete against AI bots. How high can you score in 30 seconds?

title: Loop Ghost
description: Time loop puzzle: ghosts of your past cycles automatically repeat your moves. Use them to press buttons, open passages, and escape together.

title: Car Factory For Kids
description: Build and race your dream car in Car Factory For Kids! This exciting experience combines creativity, assembly, and racing into one fun-packed adventure, making it a perfect pick for young fans of car games for kids. This playful kids car game experience brings together building and racing in a fun and interactive way. Easy controls are perfect for free car game lovers.

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: Portal Hop
description: Portal Hop is a platform puzzle game where you carry a portal above your head and use it to solve tricky challenges! Move through each level by warping yourself onto higher platforms, collecting plus and minus power-ups to adjust the height of your portal. Think smart, plan your moves, and find the perfect path to reach your destination. Ready to warp your way to victory

title: DON'T PANIC DUDE!
description:
Meet DUDE, a sassy AI who thinks you can't beat his game! Trapped in his chaotic simulation, your goal is simple: Jump, avoid deadly spikes, and survive to prove him wrong.

Features:

Fast-paced endless jumping action.

Unlock 40 unique and funny heroes.

Hilarious AI commentary and memes.

Increasing speed and difficulty.

Can you handle the chaos? Don't panic, just jump!

title: Bunnies Sort
description:
Bunnies Sort is a cute and relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to organize adorable bunnies into the correct racks.

Each rack can hold three bunnies. Think carefully and move the bunnies one by one until every rack contains three matching bunnies.

With simple controls and charming visuals, Bunnies Sort is easy to learn but becomes more challenging as more bunnies appear. Can you sort them all and complete every level?

title: Packing Line
description: Ship all the cans. Choose a box of the same color as the can. The game is over if you run out of space for boxes and the line stops.

title: Happy Egg Catch
description:
Happy Egg Catch is a fun and colorful arcade skill game where timing and precision are the key to victory!

Eggs are hanging from the top and swinging back and forth. Your goal is simple: tap at the perfect moment to release the egg and land it safely inside the basket below. But be careful, the basket moves to different positions every round, so you must aim your throw carefully!

Test your reflexes, master the swing timing, and see how many eggs you can catch in a row!

title: Garten Of BanBan 1 Escape
description:
Enter Banban's Kindergarten, and you're sure to make some friends. Explore the mysterious establishment and don't lose your life and sanity. Uncover the horrifying truth behind the place, but be careful, as you are far from alone…

The Banban And Friends Gang:
Banban’s Kindergarten has earned a special place in every kid’s heart. The reason for this is the Banban And Friends Gang, which are the establishment’s mascots and icons. At Banban’s Kindergarten, nobody’s lonely thanks to them!

title: Artillery Vs Tanks
description: In this game, you take control of an artillery unit and engage in combat against enemy tanks. The result of the battle hinges on how precisely you target your shots – will you obliterate all the tanks before they reach you, or will they overpower you? Take out your foes and collect rewards to enhance your howitzer's performance and acquire fresh, more formidable artillery weapons!

title: Merge Blocks 2048
description: Swipe to slide numbered tiles on a 4x4 grid. Match two identical blocks to merge them into a bigger number. Start from 2 and work your way up to 2048 and beyond. The board fills up with every move so plan ahead. Chain multiple merges in a row to build combos and earn bonus coins. Spend coins in the shop on power-ups like Undo, Extra Life, Score Boost, Shuffle and Head Start. Beat your high score and try to reach the highest tile possible. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Fruite Swipe
description:
Get ready for a juicy adventure with Fruit Swipe Match, Swipe and match colorful fruits to solve exciting puzzles and unlock fantastic rewards. With hundreds of challenging levels, stunning graphics, and smooth gameplay, this match-3 game will keep you entertained for hours.

Compete with friends, discover hidden treasures, and master fun power-ups. Download Fruit Swipe Match now and experience the ultimate fruit-matching fun. It's time to swipe, match, and win big!

title: Treasure Hunt Puzzle
description: Explore ruins, complete stone tablet puzzles, and collect treasures! Solve each puzzle by fitting all your blocks into the board using the symbols as hints.

title: Meme Mukbang ASMR Game
description: Welcome to Meme Mukbang ASMR Game, the ultimate livestream mukbang experience! Step into the world of a quirky mukbang streamer, where you’ll indulge in delicious dishes and share your mukbang ASMR moments with a growing audience. The more you eat and interact, the more you earn, all while building your fame in the livestream world!

title: Obby Rescue Pin
description:
Obby Rescue Pin is a brain-burning, high IQ puzzle game that is especially addictive. How you pull the pins to rescue the Obby depends entirely on your logic and strategy!
Avoid Dangers: Navigate around bombs, ferocious animals, and deadly traps.
Outsmart the Room: Unlike simple rope rescue games, this experience focuses more on strategic adventures.
Help the Escape: Clear the path to help the Obby escape out of the dangerous room.

title: Reach 2048
description: The classic 2048 puzzle — slide numbered tiles on a grid, merge them, and reach the legendary 2048 tile! Simple to learn, impossible to put down. Challenge your brain with this addictive number puzzle. Plan your moves carefully, build combos, and aim for the highest score. How far can you go beyond 2048?

title: ColorWars.io - Conquest Game
description: Color Wars is a fast-paced strategy game where you battle three opponents to control the most territory before time runs out. Deploy powerful cards like Warrior, Ranger, Thunder, and Wizard, each with unique abilities. Earn trophies by ranking in the top two and use gold to upgrade your cards. Plan smart moves, outplay rivals, and dominate the battlefield.

title: Bus Escape: Clear Jam
description:
Dismantle the bus and send the passengers home in this colorful parking puzzle that delivers both fun and a brain workout. Combining simple gameplay with increasing difficulty, the game is perfect for fans of strategic puzzles and driving simulators.
Get ready for the challenge: sort the cars, find the right solutions, and free up parking spaces. Each car and bus has a limited number of seats, so plan your moves carefully to untangle the chaotic traffic jam.

title: Candy Jewels
description: It is a candy-filled puzzle adventure full of surprises! Match candies, break chests and collect coins as you progress through countless levels. Complete fun events like Time Attack or Coin Catch and use boosters to overcome tricky obstacles even faster!

title: Grand Mahjong Connect
description:
Grand Mahjong Connect is a relaxing yet challenging triple-match puzzle game with a fresh twist on classic mahjong.

Select tiles from the board and match three identical pieces to clear them.
Plan your moves carefully — space is limited, and every choice matters!

Enjoy beautiful tiles, smooth gameplay, and satisfying match effects as you clear the board and progress through levels.

Can you master the art of triple matching?

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker is your ultimate creative escape into the world of anime character design. Craft stunning anime couples with romantic flair, dress up stylish girl avatars, and mix and match accessories, hairstyles, and outfits. With relaxing ASMR touches and a vibrant anime art style, this avatar creator lets your imagination shine in every love-filled duo you design.

title: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle
description: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle is an irresistibly fun puzzle casual game that bursts with juicy visuals and addictive gameplay! A brilliant combination of puzzle and match mechanics. From the moment you start, you’ll be hooked on its satisfying matching mechanics and clever level design.

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

title: Emoji Guess
description: Welcome to the entertaining world of Emoji Guess, a game where every emoji hides a clue. Use your creativity and logic to decode famous phrases, sayings, and movie titles represented by emoji sequences. Each level brings a fresh challenge that will test your imagination and make you smile. Play for free on your phone or computer and see how fluent you are in the universal language of emojis!

title: Mojicon Garden Connect
description: Looking for a relaxing puzzle break? The 6th Mojicon game is here to help you unwind! Mojicon Garden Connect brings the beauty of spring right to your screen. Connect colorful tiles at your own pace and watch the garden come to life. As you play, you'll unlock 20 fun, hidden Discoveries featuring adorable garden friends. Now lighter and smoother than ever, it’s the perfect polished puzzle for your downtime.

title: Doodle Dino Run
description: Doodle Dino Run delivers an addictive running adventure where you control a cute dinosaur, avoid dangers, and push your distance record farther every time you play. Featuring smooth side-scrolling gameplay, precise jump timing is essential to survive. Packed with action, this dinosaur adventure challenges your reflexes as the speed continuously increases.

title: City Tower Builder
description: In the game, you need to develop your own city, build houses, and place them around the city. You need to build the houses evenly so that the blocks don't fall to the ground. The game is a combination of a city-building simulator and an exciting arcade game where you need to build even houses out of blocks so that the blocks don't fall and the houses don't collapse.

title: Office Spider Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Spider Solitaire is to clear the table by creating suited sets from king to ace. The game has either one, two or four suits depending on the difficulty setting.

title: Obby - Escape Barry's jail parkour
description: An incredible escape from the New Barry Prison awaits you! Cool locations, parkour and obby. Show your agility to avoid getting caught by Barry.

title: Closed City
description: Shooting game about a quarantined city due to the threat of infection with a zombie virus. The main gameplay will revolve around the fact that you will need to survive in this difficult, riddled city.

title: Office Solitaire
description: Office Solitaire is the classic solitaire variant with the objective of collecting all the cards to the top row in suited sequences from ace to king.

title: Cooking Empire
description: Cooking Empire is not just a cooking game, it’s a real explosion of flavors and speed! Start frying, boiling, baking and serving dishes from all over the world with one click! Are you ready to become a chef the whole world will remember?

title: PaperWar.io
description: There are so many unexplored areas! Conquering them is the key to mastering the game. Expand your territory, eliminate other players who threaten your progress and aim to conquer 100% of each new map. Choose from 9 special skins to express your style!

title: Logic Storm: Animals Puzzle
description: Logic Farm: Animal Grid Puzzle is a relaxing yet challenging logic puzzle game where your goal is to place cute animals on a grid following specific rules. With its soft pastel aesthetics and brain-teasing levels, it’s the perfect blend of cozy gaming and mental exercise. Can you find the perfect spot for every animal? Start sorting your farm today!

title: Super Ninja Balloon
description:
Aim your sharp Ninja Shurikens and pop as many Balloons as possible in fun and exciting puzzle challenges. Create amazing combos, hit tricky shots, and clear each level with fast reflexes and smart moves.
Every victory takes you further into a colorful balloon-popping adventure filled with cheerful worlds, playful action, and satisfying explosions. Unlock new challenges, enjoy vibrant visuals, and become the Super Ninja Balloon master.

title: Pubg Hack
description: Experience the ultimate shooting adventure. In Pubg Hack, you step into the battlefield as an elite soldier, exploring massive maps and engaging in fierce combat. Select a location to land and begin searching for supplies.

title: 67 Clicker Tap Tap
description: 67 Clicker is a fast, funny, and highly addictive meme clicker game where every tap brings you closer to unlocking a strange and unforgettable collection of 67-themed characters. Your goal is simple at first: click or tap to earn 67 Points, spend them on upgrades, and keep growing your power. The ultimate objective is to reach the final upgrade, The 67 Galaxy, and unlock all 14 unique 67 characters waiting across the journey.

title: World Cup Soccer Caps
description: World Cup Soccer Caps is a fun and fast-paced tabletop-style soccer game where you control a team of caps, flicking them to pass, shoot, and score goals. Strategize your moves, outplay your opponent, and aim for victory in this exciting, skill-based challenge!

title: Jungle Solitaire
description: Jungle Spider Solitaire is an adaptation of the classic card game Spider Solitaire with a jungle theme. It is optimized for short games and encourages strategic planning of moves with an original system of collecting diamonds.

title: Royal Pin
description: Royal Pin: King Adventure – A thrilling rescue puzzle game where you save the King, protect the kingdom, and rebuild the castle! Solve tricky pin puzzles, help the queen and princess, and become the ultimate king of this adventure!

title: PopSortica
description:
PopSortica is a new chapter in Poppy’s adventures! Join the underwater SORTING voyage! Challenging yet relaxing levels await as you sort things out.
The rules are simple, but the difficulty increases with each new level.
Special obstacles and conditions will challenge your skills, while boosters will help you achieve the best results faster.
Dive deep with Mermaid Poppy and challenge yourself in this exciting sea sorting adventure!

title: Slingshot Fortress
description: Slingshot Fortress is an addictive 2D physics-based destruction game where precision, timing, and strategy are essential. Use your slingshot to launch stones, bombs, and shurikens to destroy towers, collapse structures, and uncover hidden enemies. Explore vibrant levels from forests to icy lands, unlock powerful abilities, trigger explosive chain reactions, and master increasingly challenging puzzles in this fun, casual browser game experience.

title: Worm Escape
description:
Worm Escape is a fun puzzle game that tests your logic and decision-making skills. Move worms in the correct order to clear each level. A single right move can solve the puzzle, while a wrong one can block your progress.

As you advance, levels become more complex with tighter spaces and more worms. Analyze carefully and choose the right sequence to succeed.

Simple tap controls make it easy to play, but mastering each level requires planning and strategy.

title: My Castle. Merge & Story
description:
My Castle: Merge & Story is a relaxing merge 2 puzzle game set in a warm and atmospheric medieval world of renewal, mystery, and self-discovery. Merge items, restore and decorate an ancient castle, and follow the journey of a young princess who chooses a new path in life.
This calm offline merge adventure combines cozy gameplay, castle restoration, and a story about starting over — far from royal expectations, closer to one’s true self.
Restore and Decorate a Forgotten Castle

title: Darling Doll
description: Darling Doll is the ultimate paper doll DIY game that offers a perfect blend of character creation and dress-up game. With a vast collection of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles, you can unleash your creativity and design unique avatars that reflect your personal style. Whether you prefer chibi dolls or glamorous fashion dolls, Darling Doll has got you covered.

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Ludo Star
description: Enter the arena of strategy and chance! Choose your favorite mode, unlock stylish dice skins and climb the trophy road. Outsmart opponents, master your moves and prove you’ve got what it takes to rule the board and become a Ludo Star.

title: Park Me: Draw Path
description: "Park Me: Draw Path" is a casual puzzle game integrating "painting + parking + puzzle solving", which adds "drawing lines" to the traditional parking gameplay, testing the player's logical thinking, spatial imagination and path planning ability, and getting an "intellectual exercise" in a short period of time.

title: Bloons Survival.io
description:
Bloons Survival. io is a fast-paced survival arcade game where you fight off endless waves of balloons!

Control your monkey hero, throw darts automatically, and pop incoming enemies before they get too close.
Collect coins and power-ups to grow stronger, but stay alert — one hit can end your run!

How long can you survive?

title: Jungle Match Adventures
description: Jungle Match Adventures is a brand-new Match-3 game set deep in the lush Amazon Rainforest. Join the fearless explorer Aria as she uncovers hidden treasures, ancient relics, and precious gems buried in the jungle. Match colorful stones and nature-themed items, solve fun and challenging puzzles, and unlock secrets along the way. Take part in Daily and Weekly Challenges, enjoy Daily Surprises, and progress through hundreds of exciting levels in this unforgettable jungle adventure.

title: Football Legends 2026
description: Football Legends 2026 is a fast-paced arcade soccer game where you can play solo or challenge your friends in exciting 1v1 and 2v2 matches. Choose from a variety of unique players, each with special abilities like powerful superkicks or teleportation, and use them to outplay your opponents. Compete in tournaments, master your timing and strategy, and score incredible goals to become the ultimate soccer champion

title: Fruit Merge Arena
description: Fruit Merge Arena is a fun and relaxing game where you drop fruits and merge the same ones to create bigger fruits. Keep merging step by step and try to reach the ultimate fruit — the watermelon! But be careful, space is limited and the board can fill up quickly. Plan your moves wisely and keep merging to stay in the game.Feeling stuck or running out of space? Don’t worry! You can watch a reward ad to remove all instances of a selected fruit and make room for new moves.

title: Jump to the Mountain for the Brainrots
description:
You'll play as Obby, a character located on a tall mountain.
Various Brainrots will randomly appear on the mountain, guarded by enemies.
Your task is to jump up the mountain and rescue the Brainrots. Collect the entire Brainrot collection without falling into enemy hands!
Sell Brainrots to increase your jump height and reach the very top of the mountain. Rare Brainrot species live at the very top.

title: Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY
description: Welcome to Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY, the ultimate playground for those who love to personalize, design, and express their unique style!

title: Theo Morini's Magical Resort
description:
“Theo Morini’s Magical Resort” is a magical, romantic, and captivating merge puzzle game about rebuilding a resort on an enchanted island.

Talented writers and actors created this story and brought its characters to life. Enjoy the story!

title: Word Stars
description: Find hidden words and piece together your success. Each puzzle is a step towards mastering the game and expanding your word power. Use hints to keep progressing. From the first word to the last, it’s a race to finish all the levels.

title: Tank Challenge
description:
Tank Challenge is an action-packed tank battle game that tests your reflexes and strategy. Play solo or challenge a friend in fast-paced matches.

Defeat your opponent using powerful weapons like lasers, triple bullets, bomb shells, and rockets.

Make quick decisions, aim carefully, and stay ahead to win. Smooth on mobile and desktop, easy to learn but challenging to master.

Enter the arena and fight for victory!

title: The Noob Aventures
description:
The Noob Adventures invites you to join a dangerous journey through a colorful world full of action, traps, and enemies. Travel across challenging lands in search of diamonds and overcome all obstacles. Complete 70 levels packed with danger and surprises as you fight enemies determined to stop your progress. Rescue the friends, survive the challenges along the way, and prove that even a noob can become a true hero.
Collect diamonds and unlock new characters to continue your adventure

title: Goodeluxe
description: Goo Deluxe is a Collapse game with a sticky and satisfying aesthetic. It's a simple and relaxing game. Unlike other Goobox games, Goo Deluxe is not limited by time, allowing you all the time to think. Isn't that true luxury?

title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
description: Archers Ragdoll Physics is a physics-based archery action game where ragdoll characters fight using special arrows. The game features 10 characters and 12 unique arrows such as lightning, fire, poison, missile, and rocket. Players can equip three arrows and switch between them during battles. Some levels include traps like electric cables and spinning gears that can be activated with arrows. In 2 Player Mode, players choose from 7 arrows and compete to hit their opponent the most.

title: SuperPixelint
description:
It's a game where you draw a cute little image.
You can develop color matching skills and accuracy without any burden.
Why don't you get out of your daily life for a while and heal yourself through coloring games?

title: Pixel Flow
description: Come to train your brain with colors and paths. Pixel Flow is a clean and addictive pixel puzzle game that challenges your logic and planning skills. In each level, you must send kittens of different colors into the track. Pixel points matching the kittens' colors will be eliminated. Paths cannot cross or overlap, so every move matters.

title: Smash Defense
description: Smash Defense is a chaotic baseball-inspired action game where your swings decide the fate of entire worlds. Crush waves of flying monsters using your bat and evolve your ball with fiery, electric, and explosive powers. Travel through dynamic environments like deep oceans and erupting volcanoes, upgrade your skills, and prove you’re the ultimate monster-slaying champion.

title: Merge Home Mania
description: Welcome to an exciting game where creativity meets strategy! Merge items, build unique structures and decorate your perfect home. Use materials like stone, wood, textiles, flowers and plants to create furniture and decorations. Design beautiful rooms and show off your decorating talent!

title: Jewel Link
description:
Connect matching jewels and clear the board! In Jewel Link, a Connect2 game inspired by Bejeweled, your goal is simple: find two identical jewels and link them together to make them disappear. 

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging and trickier. Placements will test your ability to think ahead and spot Connect-2 connections quickly. It’s not just about what you see - it’s about how you navigate the board to match the jewels.

title: Traffic Racing
description: Traffic Racing is a fast-paced driving game that throws you into intense highway action where every second counts. Weave through heavy traffic at high speeds as you compete in Career Mode or test your skills against others in Racing League Online.

title: Water Sort Puzzle 3
description: Face a super satisfying liquid sorting challenge with Water Sort Puzzle 3! This addictive puzzle game turns simple color sorting into a relaxing yet brain-teasing experience you won’t want to stop playing! This game is perfect for those who enjoy calm but clever challenges. It trains your logic while keeping the experience relaxing and fun. As a true casual game, it’s ideal for quick breaks and time killing, making every moment feel satisfying and rewarding!

title: Island Expander
description:
Island Expander — relaxing crafting game. Collect resources, discover 30+ recipes, and grow your island step by step!
It is a cozy crafting game where you transform a tiny island into a paradise.
Collect resources, unlock recipes, craft items — from simple tools to complex machines — and watch your island grow with every step.

Start building your dream island today! ?

title: Terra Craft World
description: Terra Craft World invites you to explore an open world where every decision shapes your journey. Begin an unforgettable adventure filled with discovery and creativity. This game perfectly blends exploration, building, and survival mechanics into one exciting experience. Whether you enjoy creating structures or overcoming environmental dangers, every moment feels rewarding and dynamic. Discover more craft and building experiences packed with creativity and exploration fun!

title: Springle Puzzle
description: Springle Puzzle is a fun and fast jigsaw game where you solve puzzles before time runs out. Choose from styles like Classic, Irregular, Hexagon, or Wave, each with a different feel. Play easy mode with fewer pieces for a quick game and lower score, or pick more pieces for a harder challenge and higher score. If time runs out, watch a reward ad and keep playing.

title: Mahjong Lines
description: Mahjong Lines is a relaxing logic puzzle in the mahjong connect style. Find matching tile pairs and clear the board by linking them with a valid path. With classic mahjong tiles, simple rules, hints, and lots of levels, it’s perfect for both quick sessions and thoughtful puzzle-solving.

title: 67 Clicker
description:
Forget everything you know about gaming. Experience the absolute peak of interactive entertainment. It’s not just a number; it’s a lifestyle. Tap the 67 and watch your empire grow.

FULLY AUTOMATED STONKS: Buy upgrades to make the 67 click itself. It’s literally free real estate.

PEAK BRAIN ROT: No thoughts, just 67. The perfect idle experience for fans of "number go up" simulators.

title: Escape from the Portal
description:
"Your soul is trapped between worlds. The only way home is to activate an ancient portal... but only one can pass through."
Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld.

title: Push.io
description: Push.io is a fast-paced arena game where you battle to stay on the map and push everyone else off. Wield your boomerang with precision to knock rivals into the water while dodging incoming attacks. The longer you survive, the higher you rank; fall early, and you’ll drop in the standings. Earn trophies, upgrade your boomerang between rounds, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate arena champion.

title: Bubble Sky
description: Bubble Sky is an ascending Bubble Shooter game that will take you to dizzying heights. Will you be able to reach space? Reach a score of 200000 points to unlock the wheel of fortune and win collectible cards to complete your album!

title: Hidden Objects Island
description: Discover the ultimate hidden objects game and embark on a journey through stunning locations, captivating puzzles, and mysterious adventures!

title: Brainrots Lava Survive Online
description: Brainrots Lava Survive Online is an intense survival experience where rising lava transforms the map into a dangerous obstacle zone. Players must collect brainrots in risky areas and escape before the lava blocks safe routes. Online mode is available in 1 Player, allowing chat and interaction, while 2 Player mode offers local shared-screen competition. With more than 60 characters in normal, gold, diamond, Celestial, and time-limited Divine tiers, progression stays dynamic.

title: Vex X3M 3
description: VEX X3M 3 is here! The most intense Vex hill racing experience yet. Race through new levels filled with traps, sand, electricity, and unpredictable terrain that test your timing and skill. Ride through pipes, master new physics, and take on hard mode or a CPU opponent. Unlock powerful bikes, beat every track, and prove you’re a true VEX X3M rider. Start your engine and take on the challenge!

title: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots
description: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots is a fast and rewarding collection game where action, risk, and strategy come together. Your mission is to break brainrot eggs, collect rare Brainrot characters, and safely deliver them to your base before time runs out. Each run is a mix of decision making and reflex.

title: Arrow Escape: Master
description: Solve funny brain puzzles by moving the arrow and finding the correct path. Each level challenges your logic, reflexes, and creativity in a light and addictive way.

title: Jump Master
description:
You can jump further if you press down on the marker.
Press and release the timing so that it doesn't fall between the footrest and the footrest!
Why don't you compete with your friends for points with the sharing function?

title: Dice Puzzle
description: Dice Puzzle is a smart, satisfying merge game where you place numbered dice on a grid to combine matches and build higher values. Plan ahead, manage limited space, and handle dice that appear solo or in pairs. Every move matters—chain merges, grow your numbers, and test your strategy in this addictive dice challenge.

title: Pixel Shoot
description: Pixel Shoot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game. It's simple to play by just tapping the cannons. Make sure you pay attention to the color and base your strategy around it. You must also manage your capacity, and timing is key! Send your cannons in the right order, manage the flow, and maximize your score.

title: Fireboy & Watergirl 7: and Friends
description:
Fireboy and Watergirl need help to explore this new temple. This time with 3 new friends that will help them solve the puzzles, beat the times and collect all the diamonds! 

Play alone or with a friend to join Fireboy and Watergirl in this new adventure!

Turn levers and push buttons to complete these 36 new levels of the official Fireboy and Watergirl series.

title: Battle Racing Stars
description: Join an epic racing adventure where you can unlock and upgrade iconic characters from beloved Halfbrick games, including Barry from Jetpack Joyride, The Ginger Ninja from Dan the Man, and the nimble ninjas from Fruit Ninja.

title: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Street of Secrets is an atmospheric hidden object game where you become the lead detective. A mysterious case awaits, and your insightful assistant is there to help, offering hints and guiding you to crucial details.

title: Savage Defenders
description: A tower defense strategy action game where you become the last hope of a tribe living at the foot of an ancient volcano. When an asteroid with an alien threat falls to the planet, you must combine magic, tactics and the strength of warriors to stop the invader who is devouring all life.

title: Grow a Garden 3D
description:
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a fun and peaceful game where you plant seeds and grow magical trees! ?
Explore different seasons, customize your character, and watch your garden grow bigger every day.
Every seed is special and every garden is unique!

title: Pixel Journey
description: The “Pixel Journey” will appeal to all fans of exploration, collecting resources in a cozy pixel world. It combines a cozy atmosphere and addictive gameplay. Reach the end and find out all the secrets! Support us by leaving a review and comment! If you have any comments or suggestions, please describe them and we will try to make improvements quickly!

title: Dragon Draw Joust
description: Prepare for a wildly creative showdown in Dragon Draw Joust, where your imagination becomes your strongest weapon! Instead of choosing gear from a menu, you must draw your own tools to defend your warrior and survive intense combat challenges. Every match feels fresh because your strategy starts with your creativity. Your creation instantly becomes part of your character, helping you block attacks or strike opponents inside the chaotic battle arena.

title: Mahjong build farm
description: A cozy blend of classic Mahjong and farm simulation! Start with a small green hill and turn it into a blooming farm by matching tiles and completing levels. The mechanics are simple and relaxing — find and match three identical picture tiles to clear the board. You'll have 90 unique levels with varying difficulty, from easy puzzles to real challenges for experienced players. If you get stuck, bonuses are always there to help.

title: Panda Dash Auto Shooting
description: Jump straight into explosive action with Panda Dash Auto Shooting! In this fast-paced side-scrolling shooting adventure, you guide a fearless panda warrior into chaotic arenas packed with endless zombie waves. Each battle throws you into intense combat where survival depends on positioning and strategy. Every round feels stronger, faster, and more thrilling than the last! Get ready, grab your gear, and dash into zombie chaos!

title: Office Knight 3D: Castle Defense
description:
Office Warrior: Wield swords and axes as skillfully as a stapler!
Action Battles: Fight various enemies in dynamic 3D environments.
Progression System: Level up, improve health and damage right in the heat of battle.
Weapon & Upgrade Shop: Collect coins to buy hero upgrades and equip yourself.
Endless Challenge: Deflect waves of enemies and prove you are the ultimate defender!

title: Battle Arena
description: Fight enemies, grow your army, and dominate the battlefield! Upgrade your camp, train your soldiers and earn tons of coins to expand your unstoppable arsenal. Ready to battle?

title: Twinkle Shooter
description: Shoot at stones of the same color to drop them. They can be cleared when three or more of the same color are matched. If a stone enters the heart, the slot spins for a fever chance! The game is over if the stones reach the bottom.

title: Bublix: Bubble Hit
description: Bublix: Bubble Hit is a fast-paced bubble shooter where precision and strategy matter. Aim, shoot, and match 3 or more bubbles to clear the board. Use clever angles, wall bounces, and combos to boost your score. With endless gameplay and rising difficulty, it’s perfect for quick, addictive sessions.

title: Revoxel 3D - Voxel RPG Shooter
description: Immerse yourself in a dynamic voxel-style RPG shooter with a cyberpunk atmosphere. A dark futuristic city overrun by a tech corporation awaits you, along with endless battles with robots and monsters, character development, and constant action in the spirit of a shooter RPG.

title: Break Beat
description: Break Beat is a fast-paced and colorful brick-breaker game with a pixel art/neon aesthetic and an electronic music soundtrack.

title: Clash & Run
description: One chance, no turning back. Speed is your only ally in a world that won’t wait. Race through ever-shifting terrain where every jump could be your last. Collect coins and unlock unique looks. Precision and quick thinking will keep you in the game longer.

title: Hard Puzzle
description:
Enter a vibrant, calming world of geometry where your goal is to build perfect squares from colorful pieces. Fit the shapes together, unlock new levels, and challenge your logic and spatial skills. Need help? Use a hint to keep going!
? Easy to play, hard to master
? Relaxing visuals
? A quick, fun brain boost anytime
Start puzzling and become a geometry master!

title: World Soccer
description:
There are four objects, pull the object you want and fire it.
The object moves and pushes the other object or ball away
If you push the ball into the net before the opponent, you win!

title: Word Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with a fresh twist on a classic with Word Solitaire! This addictive word solitaire blends clever word-building with strategic card gameplay, creating a unique solo experience. Find categories, reveal hidden words, and clear the board in increasingly challenging levels. Perfect for quick breaks or long sessions—relax, think, and master the art of words!

title: Hexa Stack
description: Welcome to Hexa Stack—an all-new hexagon puzzle that’s equal parts relaxing and challenging. Sort colorful tiles by color, stack smart to create powerful combos, and think ahead before the board fills up. Each level adds new twists, requiring focus, memory, and clever planning. Stuck? Use boosters like swap and shuffle to keep your run alive. Simple controls, satisfying merges, and nonstop brain fun!

title: Rainbow Friends. Survival
description:
A fun and dangerous game about Rainbow Friends!
You are in a dangerous place. You need to survive 5 days and 5 nights, but the deadly obstacle will be the terrifying and bloodthirsty monsters Rainbow Friends!
Complete all the missions, move fast, perform actions carefully and run away from the monstrous monsters!

title: Math Master
description: Unleash your inner math whiz! Math Master turns numbers into art—solve fun math problems to unlock drawing tools, sketch colorful shapes, and bring numerical puzzles to life. Perfect for learners and creativity lovers alike!

title: Hidden Object Adventure
description: Are you ready to solve puzzles and uncover hidden secrets? Become a detective in Find Hidden Object Game and test your observation skills! Explore detailed scenes in schools, houses, amusement parks, and zoos. Search for cleverly hidden items, challenge your brain, and enjoy fun, relaxing gameplay. Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers alike. Train your mind and become the ultimate detective!

title: Max Speed
description: Race shiny sports cars on thrilling 3D tracks full of jumps, stunts, and intense battles. Explore exciting locations with unique challenges, perform daring tricks, upgrade and customize your cars, and test your skills in fast-paced arcade races. Enjoy high-speed action, stunning visuals, and nonstop adrenaline right in your browser.

title: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets is an exciting hidden object game where magic and time intertwine in a thrilling adventure. Everything changed when a mysterious magical crystal activated, scattering objects across time! You'll enter a world of riddles, hidden objects, and temporal paradoxes.

title: Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic
description:
Rediscover the captivating world of Solitaire Klondike!

This timeless card game not only entertains but also enhances logical thinking, offering hours of engaging pastime. Play your favorite solitaire anytime, anywhere.

Join the community of enthusiasts and prove your mastery in Klondike!

Keep an eye on the leaderboard and become the top player among all!

title: Papas Burger Cook
description:
Cook and travel through amazing burger restaurants, discover delicious recipes, prepare tasty meals, and serve hungry customers in the best burger shop.
This is a crazy cooking game full of fast kitchen action, burger fever, and food madness. Papas Burger Cook - fun cooking simulation game.
Become the ultimate burger chef, master every recipe, and reach the highest rank in this exciting food cooking adventure.

title: Dino Hunter King
description: Action-packed FPS games have long attracted players. Enjoy dinosaur hunting in Dino Hunter King. Enter a wild prehistoric world, become an elite hunter tracking powerful dinosaurs across open grasslands.

title: Food Tower Defense
description: ? Welcome to Food Tower Defense – The Tastiest Tower Defense Ever! ?? Prepare your appetite and sharpen your strategy because Food Tower Defense is here to serve you the most delicious tower defense experience ever!

title: Break the block there, Brainrot!
description:
Break the block there, Brainrot! — Break blocks and collect the entire Brainrot collection.
Sell Brainrots to earn points to upgrade your axe.
Find rare Brainrots in blocks. The further you go to collect the blocks, the greater the reward, but beware of the block guard.

title: Chroma Tower
description: Chroma Tower is a reverse-Tetris puzzle where you destroy instead of build! You're given a tower made of colored blocks. Drop blocks from above, match the color — and the entire connected chain disappears. Blocks fall to fill the gaps, potentially triggering new cascade reactions. Your goal is to demolish the tower completely within a limited number of moves.

title: Animal Merge Zoo Park
description:
Animal Merge Zoo Park is a fun and addictive idle zoo simulation game where you build, manage, and expand your very own wildlife empire. Start with a small zoo and grow it into a world filled with animals, wild beasts, dinosaurs, monsters, and magical creatures like unicorns. Become the ultimate zoo tycoon by merging creatures, caring for animals, producing food, managing visitors, and unlocking new zones.
Merge Animals and Discover New Species

title: Car Jam Escape
description: Car Jam Escape is a puzzle game where players clear a crowded parking lot by moving cars in the correct order. Each vehicle can only move forward in the direction it faces, so players must study the layout and plan carefully. The goal is to guide every car out without collisions or blockages. As levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring logical thinking and strategy.

title: Dinosaurs vs Asteroids
description: Giant asteroids are crashing down on Earth. But the dinosaurs have a plan! They have special mounts on their backs where you can attach a variety of weapons: from miniguns and flamethrowers to alien shotguns and blasters. Additionally, there are special species of dinosaurs that can shoot powerful spikes or break asteroids with their claws.

title: Meow Block: Color Collect!
description: A burst of color, clever thinking, and adorable cats await you in Meow Block: Color Collect! This charming puzzle experience turns simple movements into brain-teasing fun, where every swipe matters and every match brings you closer to victory.

title: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator
description: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator is a 3D strategy battle game where planning is the key to victory. Build your army of Swordsmen, Spearmen, and Archers, analyze enemy formations, and lead your ninja forces to triumph across challenging levels.

title: Underwater Survival
description:
Dive Into a Mysterious and Beautiful Underwater World
Welcome to an unforgettable underwater survival adventure where exploration, discovery, and survival come together in a stunning ocean environment. Dive deep into a vibrant and mysterious sea filled with hidden secrets, breathtaking visuals, and endless possibilities.

title: EQ Test Puzzle
description: A puzzle game that tests emotional intelligence through emotion recognition and jigsaw puzzles. Match emotional icons, scenarios, and puzzle pieces to train your emotional awareness and problem-solving skills.

title: Jigsolitaire
description: Step into a peaceful world of beautiful images made from gentle, carefully crafted blocks. Jigsolitaire is a game you’ll want to return to every day: it helps you unwind, disconnect from stress, and enjoy a small moment of calm just for yourself. Each level reveals a new scene - warm landscapes, charming cottages, delicate nature details, and quiet corners you’ll love exploring piece by piece.

title: Spa empire
description:
? BUILD YOUR DREAM SPA EMPIRE

Have you ever dreamed of running the ultimate spa, offering everything from soothing massages to exciting makeovers? Step into My Spa Empire, the idle arcade game where you dye hair, create stunning hair color makeovers and manage a bustling spa filled with exciting treatments. Design, upgrade, and expand your spa into the ultimate relaxation haven for your guests.

title: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash
description: Welcome to the Y2K style fashion world! Two charismatic heroines are waiting for you, ready to try on fashion trends from the 2000s. Create spectacular makeup for them with lip gloss, shining shadows and glossy skin; choose stylish hairstyles - from smooth straight hair to playful ponytails and fashionable hairpins. Experiment with low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, shiny fabrics, and bold combinations. Complete the resulting image with iconic accessories of those years.

title: SCP 173 Escape
description: Step into the role of SCP-173 and break free from the Foundation’s control in a tense stealth experience built around a deadly rule: you can MOVE only when no one is LOOKING at you. Hide in the shadows, avoid patrols, and choose the perfect moment to dash through dark corridors where every mistake leads to capture.

title: Pyramidz2
description: PyramidZ 2 is, as the name suggests, the sequel to PyramidZ. It's a Match-3 game where you have to slide a row or column to align Egyptian symbols. This version is faster and allows for more combos.

title: Farm Animal Sort Puzzle
description: Welcome to Farm Animal Sort Puzzle, a fun and relaxing casual puzzle game set on a lively farm. Your mission is simple but addictive: match the appropriate animal or vegetable to the customer's needs. Sort adorable farm animals into the correct spaces and enjoy the satisfying challenge of smart organization.

title: Animal Swipe
description: Animal Swipe is a fun and addictive puzzle game where players match adorable animal pairs on a colorful board. With easy-to-learn controls and exciting power-ups, the game offers a challenge for both casual and strategic players. Use your wits and boosts to clear levels and achieve your objectives!

title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo
description: Welcome to Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo, a unique and immersive game that lets you unleash your inner tattoo artist. This isn't just any game; it's your gateway to a world where art meets relaxation, and where your creativity can truly shine. Prepare to immerse yourself in the satisfying and intricate process of tattooing, all at the tip of your fingers!

title: Yoga Master
description:
Yoga is a great way to improve your quality of life. It is also a great way to entertain yourself in this game: Yoga Master.

Yoga Master is an addictive 3D running game with different levels that will challenge even the fastest reflex.

title: Sort Balls - Cones
description: Immerse yourself in a calming logic puzzle where your goal is to sort colored balls into separate tubes. Plan each move carefully so that every tube contains balls of only one color. The straightforward mechanics gradually evolve into more challenging levels that test your focus and strategic thinking.

title: i8 City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning supercar through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Wonders of Egypt Match 2
description: Wonders of Egypt Match 2 returns with a brand-new Match-3 adventure in Ancient Egypt! Travel with your loyal Sphinx through pyramids, temples, palaces, and towering obelisks. Match 3+ sparkling gems to uncover treasures, artifacts, and hidden secrets. Conquer hundreds of fresh levels, complete tricky goals, and use powerful boosters when you need a helping hand. Earn dazzling rewards and prove your skills as the mysteries of the desert unfold in every chapter! Ready to play? Step in and match!

title: World Cup 2026 Soccer Game
description:
Choose your national team and enter the excitement of the World Cup! 
Play as your favorite heroes like Cristiano Ronald, Lionel Messi or Kylian Mbappe and jump into fast-paced 1v1 soccer battles to claim the cup! 
Defend your goal, watch for the perfect opening, and strike to score!
Challenge the CPU or compete against friends, sharpen your skills, and climb your way to the top. Victory is just a goal away!

title: Home Block Story
description: Step into a world of renovation! Match blocks, clear the board and unlock new decor to design your house just the way you want. With each new challenge, show your unique style and make your dream home a reality.

title: Geometry Missile
description: Navigate your missile through challenging geometric obstacle courses! Control a triangular missile that automatically flies forward while you tap to guide it up and down. Avoid collisions with various shapes like triangles, rectangles, and spikes to reach the gate at each level's end. Test your reflexes in this fast-paced arcade adventure!

title: Slinger Block
description: Guide a red square through compact grid-based puzzles filled with sliding blocks and locked paths. Clear the way, collect every yellow key, unlock the yellow door, and reach the exit to win. Simple rules, clever layouts, and satisfying logic challenges make each level a fun brain teaser.

title: Sworded.io - Spin and Rub.
description: Test your skills in the game – an arcade simulator of sword fights! Fight waves of enemies, upgrade your character, unlock powerful weapons and magic spells. Demonstrate your tactics and reaction in dynamic battles!

title: My Arcade Center 2
description:
My Arcade Center 2 is a fast-paced arcade management tycoon game.

Build, customize, and expand your own arcade across 7 unique maps. Earn by day, upgrade by night, unlock new machines, hire staff, optimize layouts, and grow your business. Switch between centers anytime, unlock new characters and skins, complete daily missions, and boost your long-term progress with rewarding upgrades.

title: Geometry Tower Defense
description: Fast, stylish tower defense game where geometric towers blast incoming enemies along winding paths. Build on key spots, upgrade and sell towers, manage gold, and survive wave after wave. Use speed controls to handle pressure and protect your base.

title: Dead Paradise
description: Dead Paradise: Race Shooter is an apocalyptic car game where you drive, shoot enemies, and try to survive until the finish. Completing levels gives you coins to upgrade your car’s missiles, armor, engine, and fuel. You can also buy new vehicles, take missions, and complete daily tasks for extra rewards. Use your resources wisely to make your car stronger and improve your chances of survival.

title: Jumper's Quest
description:
Jump into a world full of unique obstacles that will test you both mentally and physically. Your quick thinking and reflexes will be put to the test as you decipher puzzles and navigate through each level with finesse.

Encounter a diverse array of enemies, each with their own unique challenges that you must conquer. Intuitive one-touch controls empower you to effortlessly jump through the levels in record time.

title: Hospital Inc
description: Step into the fast-paced world of Hospital Inc, an exciting management simulator. This addictive idle tycoon casual game lets you build, expand, and manage your own hospital while earning profits even when you're away.

title: Bimka Drive - Smash cars into splinters!
description: Game created in the style of racing, where you will have no restrictions. But it's not that simple. The fact is that the basis here is based on the physics of actions, because every collision of your car with any obstacle will significantly affect its both external and internal condition. The damage model is made very realistically. Your choice will be a variety of different types of car models that you can test on all kinds of racing tracks. The game is very similar to "BeamNG Drive".

title: Pim Path
description:
Reach the trophy at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem. You can't fall off the platforms; spikes and blades will be everywhere, making the levels more challenging. One wrong step and it's game over.
You'll need to stay calm, pay attention, be agile, have good reflexes, and most importantly, don't get angry.

title: Liquid Sort Deluxe
description: Liquid Sort Deluxe is a relaxing and addictive color sorting puzzle game where you sort colorful liquids into tubes until each tube contains only one color. Plan your moves carefully and challenge your brain with unlimited levels. Unlock an extra tube by watching a short reward ad to make the puzzle easier, or get unlimited time to complete tricky levels.

title: Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D
description: Step into the battlefield and test your precision in Gun Shooting Games: Sniper 3D, an exciting fps experience packed with nonstop action. This immersive first person shooting game puts you in the role of an elite sniper armed with powerful weapons and challenging missions.

title: Obby: Tsunami Escape +1 by Car
description:
A giant tsunami is approaching - and only you can outrun it! Dodge the waves, upgrade your car, and race to the finish line. The faster you get, the further you can go.

Buy new cars - each one gives you more speed, control, and capabilities.
Upgrade your vehicles to survive the most challenging races.
Defeat brainrots - from common to rare and legendary ones.
Practice, improve your reactions, and find the perfect strategy.

title: Romantic K-Pop Transformation
description: In this game, the stars of K-pop are preparing for a romantic transformation. Create a unique images for girls, full of tenderness and brilliance of the stage. Experiment with makeup; change the hairstyles and hair color of the girls. Choose the perfect outfit: from cute dresses and stylish tops to trendy skirts and trousers. Complete the look with fashion accessories. Compare the resulting images and decide which of the heroines of the game has become the real queen of romantic K-pop style.

title: Europe at War
description:
Europe stands on the brink of the greatest conflict in history. It's 1936 - choose your nation and decide the fate of the continent.
Europe at War is a turn-based strategy with a detailed map of Europe divided into 369 regions. Manage your economy, build factories and barracks, research technologies, forge alliances or declare wars.
Three paths to victory: conquer all regions by force, unite Europe through diplomatic alliances, or build an industrial empire of 12 factories.

title: Cow Jam Farm puzzle
description: In Cow Jam Farm Puzzle, the peaceful farm turns into a tricky traffic jam that only your logic skills can solve. Cows are stuck in crowded paths, and your mission is to help every one of them escape safely.

title: Word Search Universe Easter
description: Word Search Universe: Easter is a fun and relaxing puzzle game with a happy spring theme. Enjoy colorful eggs, soft colors, and a peaceful mood while finding hidden words. Easy to play and great for all ages, it’s a perfect way to relax and enjoy the Easter season.

title: Stick Kill 3D
description: Play as a stickman armed with a pistol in this puzzle-based shooter, where precision and clever thinking are key. Find the right angle, line up your shots, and eliminate enemies in creative ways. Each level becomes more challenging, testing your accuracy and problem-solving skills.

title: Diamondz
description: DiamondZ is a special variant of Match-3. Here, the goal is not to directly manipulate jewels on the board but to insert them on the left or right side to eliminate groups and make diamonds fall into the mine carts. Help the little miner collect as much wealth as possible!

title: Brawl Stars Battle
description: Brawl Stars Battle is an exciting action shooting game where you control powerful heroes armed with guns and special abilities to defeat opponents in fast-paced combat! Select 3v3 battle mode and fight alongside your teammates. The team that kills fifteen opponents first wins. Use guns and powerful abilities in intense battles.

title: BAT!zo Runner
description: Become the cutest vampuuurrr bat! Fly, dodge, and collect mysterious red potions in BAT!zo - new addictive endless runner!

title: Two RX7 Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful rx7. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Slicer Duo
description: Slicer Duo is a satisfying ASMR game where precision, timing, and rhythm come together in a sharp slicing adventure. Move through level-based stages, cut through fruits and all kinds of objects, collect points, and try to keep your knife in motion for as long as possible. While the controls are simple, every section demands focus because one bad move can send your knife straight into danger.

title: Number Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West number bubble shooter! Shoot and match numbers to merge them into higher values, creating bigger combos and clearing the board. Plan your shots, stack smart, and ride through dusty levels full of challenge and fun!

title: X to Y: Almost Impossible!
description: X to Y is a fast-paced precision platform skill game focused on timing, reflexes, and speed control. Guide X through dangerous obstacles, traps, and tight spaces to reach Y. Every move requires perfect acceleration and sharp reactions — one mistake and you fail. Earn up to 3 stars per level to unlock new worlds, including dark mode challenges, auto-movement stages, and physics-based puzzles.

title: Mojicon Spring Connect
description:
The 5th Mojicon game is here! Relax and enjoy the peaceful Spring season. Guided by your cheerful and cheeky Bunny companion, embark on a soothing puzzle journey to bring a barren landscape back to life. Match tactile spring tiles to clear the board and earn rewards!

Restore the Meadow: Follow a heartwarming story.
Collect Cards: Find 34 beautiful "Spring Wisdoms".
Relax: Enjoy classic tile-matching mechanics.
Achievements: Go for 100% completion!

title: Tic Tac Toe Merge
description:
Tic-Tac-Toe Merge is a revolutionary twist on the classic game! Unlike traditional tic-tac-toe, pieces have power levels from 1 to 3. Place higher-level pieces to capture your opponent's weaker ones!

MERGE TO DOMINATE
Combine two level-1 pieces to create level-2, and two level-2 to forge powerful level-3. Create chain reactions when 3+ same-level pieces align — they merge into an even stronger piece!

title: Cute Craft Lab
description: Step into the colorful world of Cute Craft Lab, a super casual game where creativity shines and every girl can become a true crafting designer. If you love relaxing gameplay mixed with adorable creativity, this cute design adventure is made just for you. In Cute Craft Lab, enter a magical workshop filled with charming tools, sparkling decorations, and endless crafting possibilities.

title: Bunnyhop and Surf Maps
description: Game that brings bunnyhop and surf from "Counter Strike" straight to your browser! The game features a variety of parkour maps, many knife skins, unique bunnyhop mechanics, the ability to accelerate with a knife, and the opportunity to compete with other players to see who can reach the finish line first.

title: Goods Sorting Shopping Master
description: In Goods Sorting Shopping Master, you organize messy goods by moving and matching them into neat groups. It’s a fun puzzle game that combines smart thinking with relaxing gameplay. In the game, you’ll face shelves filled with mixed goods such as drinks, snacks, and daily items. Match and sort three identical items to clear the space and proceed, based on the customer's needs. Manage space carefully to keep sorting.

title: Gummy merge
